risk_note: RV2 by path (orders, union, db, guard pin). Row quarantine for order sync, BR-CALC-03 and D10-570: one row with a missing or non-numeric field no longer stops the platform's sync. CallCtx.rowErrors 'collect' is opened only by orders' fetchWindow; without it listOrders behaves as before. jd, pdd and taobao list per-row mapping failures in Page.rejected, while page-structure, window and configuration errors still throw. Rejected rows go to order_sync_pending with the new reason ORDER_ROW_INVALID (migrations 0119 and 0120, one APPROVED_GUARD_CHANGES pin), a P1 log and the existing gauge with alert CouliOrderRowInvalid. No order row, no snapshot, never 0. Good rows store and the cursor advances. A page with no good row and at least 5 bad rows still throws so the cursor stops (upstream format change). A good row that is inserted, updated or confirmed unchanged resolves the open record in the same transaction, with source and raw_payload_id in the note; row:<sha> placeholder rows are manual only. A bad order number that cannot be an order key skips the lock and is still recorded. Taobao negative settlements stay as they are, tracked as FU-TAOBAO-NEGATIVE-SETTLE (D10-572). Ruling D10-573: order_sync_pending.status has no state machine or generated transition, so the direct write to resolved stands.
